resources.string: Keeps DropGlass alerts ready to appear over other apps.
Test alerts for the DropGlass overlay.
Pick a preview or send a real system alert to see it appear beneath the camera cutout.
Grant notification access and display-over-apps so DropGlass can replace heads-up banners with its own overlay.
1. Enable Notification Access & Display Over Apps above so DropGlass intercepts incoming alerts in real time.
2. To hide ColorOS\'s duplicate stock banner, open Settings → Notifications & Status Bar → App notifications and turn off Banner for apps you want in DropGlass.
3. In Battery → App management, set DropGlass to Allow background activity & Auto-launch so the overlay stays alive between notifications.
